patch_description:
Replaces the seed ansatz (RY+RZ → linear CZ chain → RZ) with an interleaved brick-wall design:
RY layer → CNOT even-pairs → RZ layer → CNOT odd-pairs (with ring closure 7→0).

Key structural changes:
- Brick-wall CNOT entanglement (even/odd pairing) replaces linear CZ chain, achieving full ring connectivity in depth 2 instead of depth 7
- Removed redundant post-entanglement RZ layer; rotations are interleaved between entangling layers for better expressivity per parameter
- Ring closure (7→0) ensures all qubits are entangled within each block
- 16 params per block (vs 24), 98 total (vs 146), ~33% reduction
- Lower depth and fewer gates for faster convergence
